gloss: the next day; the following day

definitions.gloss: the next day; the following day (in a narrative)
definitions.explanation: The day after the day just mentioned. Used in storytelling and writing about the past, not for "tomorrow" from today's point of view.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あ}くる{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{寝|ね}ていた→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I slept all day the day after the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{明|あ}くる{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{笑|わら}い{合|あ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two of them had a fight, but the next day they were laughing together as if nothing had happened.

notes:
⟦{明|あ}くる→明ける：21288_akeru⟧ is an old pre-noun meaning "next", also seen in {明|あ}くる{年|とし} (the next year) and ⟦{明|あ}くる→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (the next morning).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the next day — the standard word, also in writing
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: the next day — everyday conversation
- ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧: tomorrow — counted from today, unlike {明|あ}くる{日|ひ}
